name: Sync OneNote Markdown exports
description: Daily sync of selected OneNote sections to Markdown.

steps.label: Main
steps.prompt: Use the onenote-md skill to sync changed pages only for these OneNote sections: "<SectionName1>" and "<SectionName2>". Destination root: "<Destination>". For each section, run the local CLI via the .cmd launcher with the sync command and the specified destination. After each run, inspect the console output and validation log. Report the section, status, errors count, latest folder, manifest path, and log path. Do not include OneNote page body content in the response.
